html:
Ba Na is a tourist area combining resort tourism and the leading entertainment areas in Vietnam, located at an altitude of 1,487m above sea level, known as a paradise, coming here visitors will feel the climate of 4 colors in 1 day.

Ba Na Hills welcomes visitors with famous landmarks, cool climate, interesting games, vibrant festivals and rich cuisine.

Ba Na Hills is currently an indispensable destination in the Da Nang tour itinerary of domestic and international tourists, with a world record cable car system, from the cable car visitors can admire the gentle Mo stream, Toc Tien Waterfall, Hoi An…

What are the attractions in Ba Na?

Coming to Ba Na, visitors should visit the French Village to experience the lively space, imbued with the poetic character of a classic France. Here, visitors will encounter squares, towns, villages, hotels, explore the Saint Dennis church, with ancient stone walls.

Golden Bridge, a virtual living spot sought by many tourists, located at an altitude of 1,414m above sea level, the bridge has been voted one of the most beautiful bridges in the world.

Sun God Waterfall

A unique work of art located right on the top of Chua Mountain, with legendary statues, with the reproduction of works being stored in major museums…

Fantasy Park entertainment area

This is one of the leading entertainment areas, suitable for visitors of all ages, especially those who love thrills. In addition, visitors can also visit the dinosaur park with many interesting games.

Festivals taking place in Ba Na

  • The Sun Festival takes place from January to August
  • The Spring Flower Festival takes place from January to March such as: tulip festival, peach bell, hydrangea, rose festival… creating a poetic and romantic scene.
  • The Summer Festival takes place from April to August, with many exciting events, visitors can immerse themselves in the space of street music, the B’estival festival is filled with intoxication, melodious music will bring visitors a perfect vacation when traveling to Da Nang – Ba Na.

The Moon Festival in Ba Na (Ba Na Moon Festival)

The festival usually takes place from September to December, in a vibrant atmosphere, with many impressive miniatures, and this is also an opportunity for visitors to enjoy a peaceful Christmas season, along with the New Year festival in Ba Na.

What to eat when traveling to Ba Na?

This is a question for tourists who travel to Ba Na for the first time, however, when coming to Ba Na, tourists have many delicious dishes to choose from, depending on the preferences of tourists, Ba Na currently has the following main culinary areas:

  • French Village
  • Du Dome Square
  • Le Jardin Flower Garden

There are many restaurants, with a very diverse Asian and European cuisine prepared by talented chefs, very fresh, tourists can choose from buffet or separate dishes.

So let’s go with Vietlook Travel to Da Nang today, and don’t forget to visit Ba Na to see with your own eyes, participate in games or enjoy the delicious dishes that this place brings to visitors.
